title: Faked Gemini spacewalk photo of Michael Collins

tellings.quote: And the Gemini 15 photo, I think, as you pointed out, is verifiably fake.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a photo from Gemini, NASA's two-person spaceflight programme of the 1960s, said to show astronaut Michael Collins on a spacewalk, is verifiably fake. He refers to it as the Gemini 15 photo and says his guest had pointed this out. He brings it up because, if true, it would mean NASA's official picture record cannot always be taken at face value.
